bounded_macro_envelope.successful_cycle_definition: one canonical append executed under the active macro authorization whose exact persisted segment is reachable from governed branch HEAD, whose full chain replays PASS post-persistence, and whose cycle evidence confirms no STOP condition
bounded_macro_envelope.consecutive_success_rule: a material activation-protocol correction or failed/blocked append resets the consecutive-success count; unrelated Git drift does not
bounded_macro_envelope.completion_rule: pilot qualifies only after at least 3 consecutive successful macro-authorized cycles and full final replay
bounded_macro_envelope.exhaustion_rule: if qualification is not achieved within 5 authorized cycles, STOP BLOCKED_HUMAN_REVIEW

event_admission_authority.occurrence_basis_required: event occurrence must be supported by an explicit human declaration or independently existing canonical evidence that was not created solely to advance the MCEPR pilot
eligible_occurrence_sources: explicit human statement describing an actually occurred research-provenance event
immutable canonical repository artifact evidencing an actually occurred research-provenance event
other immutable evidence already admissible under the frozen MCEPR event schema and applicable governance
ineligible_occurrence_sources: an event manufactured solely to satisfy pilot cycle count
event_admission_authority.semantic_gate: if actual occurrence, material research-provenance relevance, truthful field population, or decisive-reference meaning is ambiguous, STOP BLOCKED; the executing system may not resolve the ambiguity by self-assertion
event_admission_authority.cutover_gate: occurred_at_utc must be strictly greater than 2026-10-02T17:19:21Z
event_admission_authority.relation_gate: zero relations throughout the initial macro pilot

bounded_execution_model.insufficient_current_events_rule: if fewer real eligible events are available than required to complete the pilot during the authorized execution, do not fabricate or wait; execute only what is safely authorized/available and STOP with INSUFFICIENT_REAL_FORWARD_EVENTS when completion cannot be reached
per_cycle_mandatory_checks: verify every prior canonical segment path and blob remains byte-identical
